title: Governed generated-artifact refresh request bridge V2 re-registration

phases.objective: Re-register the read-only pull_request_target request evaluator under a fresh GitHub Actions path while preserving its public workflow name, permissions, artifact contract, exact-head checks, dispatcher binding, and no-mutation boundary.

e2e_journeys.actor: repository contract maintainer and GitHub Actions workflow registry
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Merge of a reviewed request-bridge workflow move to the protected default branch
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: GitHub receives the fresh bridge-v2 workflow path, the retired path is absent, and the existing trusted dispatcher continues to subscribe to the unchanged public request workflow name.
steps: Create governed-generated-artifact-refresh-pr-target-bridge-v2.yml from the exact existing read-only request workflow content.
Remove the stale bridge path in the same reviewed branch without force push.
Update active path references in the focused bridge test and permanent E2E contract.
Run the focused bridge contract and repository workflow governance checks.
After merge, emit one labeled human-authored synchronize event and require an observed request artifact, dispatcher decision, and delegated writer run ID.
assertions: The public workflow name remains Governed Generated Artifact Refresh PR Target Request so the existing dispatcher binding is unchanged.
The retired bridge path is absent and bridge-v2 is present.
Automatic execution remains pull_request_target synchronize only, with explicit workflow_dispatch retained for exact-head recovery.
Permissions remain contents:read and pull-requests:read, with no actions:write, issues:write, or contents:write.
The request workflow performs no checkout, API mutation, comment publication, workflow dispatch, git push, or secret access.

Same-repository identity, open non-draft state, base main, governed branch syntax, exact current head, explicit refresh label, protected-branch rejection, and bot-recursion rejection remain mandatory.
The existing dispatcher and sole writer authority are not modified by this re-registration.
No generated artifact mutation, migration, SQL, deployment, Production mutation, provider call, credential access, external send, direct protected-branch write, or force push occurs in this PR.

phases.objective: Observe the first labeled human synchronize event schedule the re-registered request workflow and produce an eligible exact-head request artifact.
Continue to fail closed for stale heads, missing labels, drafts, forks, protected targets, invalid branches, and bot-authored synchronizations.
This repository workflow registration repair performs no provider or deployment canary.
This repair grants no migration, runtime, deployment, provider, credential, or Production authority.
